relations.note: a sentence he will not let stand

story.body: You heard yourself praise the year and you stopped the sentence. The page stayed as it was.

story.body: You did not start the next stretch. The margin says to leave the page, and you left it.

relations.note: a grievance admired, and not paid, at his table

story.body: You wrote the supper down as one sum. The salt-fish changed hands. The paper was not divided.
